negative_reviews.author: Lilly Sabua
negative_reviews.text:
Really disappointed.

After spending around £50 on a takeaway order through Deliveroo two of us became unwell following the meal. Given the cost, I had been really looking forward to it which made the experience even more disappointing. I raised the issue appropriately through Deliveroo and was then contacted directly by the restaurant who initially handled the matter professionally and apologetically. I was told they would be “more than happy to oblige” a refund via Deliveroo and was also offered a complimentary meal as a goodwill gesture.

Unfortunately, since then the experience has been extremely frustrating and has dragged on for months on end with very little resolution.

I was repeatedly passed back and forth between the restaurant and Deliveroo with both parties giving conflicting information about who was responsible for processing the refund. Deliveroo stated the restaurant needed to approve it through their system while the restaurant later advised me to contact Deliveroo directly instead. At one stage, Deliveroo even confirmed that the refund had not been approved by the restaurant.

Communication throughout has been incredibly poor. Emails regularly went unanswered for weeks at a time and despite multiple assurances that the issue would be resolved, I am still left without a proper outcome months later.

What has disappointed me most is not even the original issue itself but the lack of consistent communication, accountability and follow-through afterwards. I remained patient and polite throughout the process but being left chasing repeatedly for months has been exhausting and unnecessarily stressful.

It’s a real shame, as I had genuinely been excited for the meal and initially appreciated the restaurant’s willingness to help. However the handling of the situation afterwards has unfortunately let the entire experience down.

negative_reviews.author: Kimlee Wilson-Miller
negative_reviews.text: The restaurant looks cool and the staff are nice, but I just had the most underwhelming and overly sweet chasu pork yaki soba. I have just double checked the online menu now and this dish was supposed to have vegetables in it too... mine just had a few spring onions and bonito flakes. I feel bad as I recommended this restaurant to my party of friends as I had a decent ramen the month before. But this yaki soba was very poor so I doubt I will be back. Also the waitress brought our bill over before we we finished and it was well before closing time and there were tables free. Atmosphere is nice though.

negative_reviews.author: S Young
negative_reviews.text: 10/10 recommendations and service from Sarah, thank you!

negative_reviews.author: Sadia Rahman
negative_reviews.text: I visited yesterday after seeing the lunch menu on instagram, however we weren’t offered the lunch menu. After over half an hour of waiting for staff to come to our table, we approached them asking about the menu. After another 10 mins or so of waiting, we approached wait staff again to place our order. The food came out quickly but it was nothing special. Other tables had arrived, ate and left but we were waiting for staff to come to our table majority of the time. At the end we had to approach staff again to pay for the bill as they would not come to our table. Usually you would make eye contact or wave but no one would look in our direction. They also billed us for individual items and we had to correct them about the lunch offer. Service charge was also added despite the lack of service. I don’t know what’s more disappointing the lack of transparency about their companies offers or that the staff aren’t attentive towards paying customers. I do not recommend and will not be returning.

negative_reviews.author: Blyiena ash
negative_reviews.text: I had a disappointing experience at Maki Ramen because of my interaction with the manager, Imi. During my visit, I felt unwelcome due to his tone and attitude. His comments came across as sarcastic, and his laughter felt dismissive rather than friendly. The way he spoke to customers made me feel like he didn't want us there and that we should leave the restaurant. Customer service is an important part of the dining experience, and unfortunately, this interaction left a negative impression on me. I visited last week and I will not  be returning. I would not recommend this restaurant to others.

negative_reviews.author: Colleen Mei
negative_reviews.text:
Maki&Ramenは他の都市の店舗でも何回か訪れたことがあります。料理(特にラーメン)はJapanese "inspired" ramenという感じで、美味しい食事に辿り着くことに困らないロンドンに出店したことに驚きでした。とてもチャレンジャーですね。
イギリスらしく決して安い価格帯ではないので、きちんとした日本食を食べたい方は他のお店をおすすめします。ビーガンラーメンを探してる方にはいいかもしれません。

(Translated by Google)
I've visited Maki&Ramen several times at their other locations in different cities. Their food (especially the ramen) is a kind of "Japanese-inspired" ramen, and I was surprised they opened a branch in London, a city where finding delicious food is already a challenge. They're quite the risk-taker.

As is typical in the UK, the prices aren't cheap, so if you're looking for authentic Japanese food, I'd recommend other restaurants. It might be a good option for those looking for vegan ramen.

negative_reviews.author: Lesley Harding
negative_reviews.text:
Disappointing.
The food is simple and of similar quality to popular takeaway sushi chains. The fish was not of the quality promised. Rice was not seasoned and despite advertising fresh wasabi online this was at an additional cost. Dry ice used on the omakase set felt gimmicky and unnecessary. Gyoza were oily and tasted frozen. Sea bream crudo was incredibly sweet. Cheese tart was overcooked, not enjoyable and came very late.

Staff did not seem informed about the food - for example they were not to able to explain to us what fish was being used for the day for the omakase set.

Our waiter, however, did try very hard to make up for the shortcomings of the restaurant and we could see he was doing his very best to be as helpful as possible.

The restaurant itself was also surprisingly worn despite having opened fairly recently. Table did not look clean and seating very tightly spaced  around it so not very comfortable for 4 adults. Additionally, we were not given anything to clean our hands with prior to being served the handrolls directly by the chef.

Having eaten at many other Japanese restaurants in London and Japan this did not represent the best Japanese food London has to offer which was a shame.

negative_reviews.author: Jennifer Smith
negative_reviews.text: Food was fantastic the service unfortunately was not. For such a small restaurant with so many staff it truly baffled me how the service could be so bad.

negative_reviews.author: Sean Low
negative_reviews.text:
Food wasn’t great. Tuna was really fishy and the colour was off, more gray than anything. Had a piece of plastic in my ceviche as well. Negitoro roll was lacking any shred of negi… Food was sitting at the counter for a long time waiting to be served or completed. Service staff were trying their best but seemed understaffed.

The place prides itself on a 15s rule for eating their hand rolls but most of them were all done at the same time. Seaweed wasn’t very crispy as a result. The sushi rice has too much vinegar and is way too sour.

Waited 45 minutes from ordering hand rolls to finally being served. Service staff were apologetic though. But the food was really poor.
